decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit closely with the firm's dental materials and custom manufacturing capabilities, and its in-house R&D and quality systems make it likely to learn from market feedback rather than withdraw the product.
A PETG thermoforming blank is highly related to the firm's existing laboratory materials and workflow expertise, so absorptive capacity is strong and supports continued refinement and retention.
UV-curing lacquer is still related to the firm's materials know-how, but it is a more specialised adjacent product and therefore somewhat more at risk if demand or fit remains limited.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build directly on the firm's established earmold and hearing-care knowledge base, so a large experienced German manufacturer with its own R&D would usually keep and improve this offering.
